Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (Freeze-dried samples homogenised using boron carbide mortar and pestle or agate ball mill. ~10 mg dried material digested for 3 h at 80°C with 100 µl HNO3 (65%, suprapure, Merck) in tightly closed 2-ml Eppendorf tubes. Digests made up to 2 ml with double distilled water.)

1 protocol:
Analytical Protocol - Atomic absorption spectroscopy: (Cu determined using Varian SpectrAA 880 Zeeman instrument with GTA 110 graphite tube atomiser. Ashing temperature 800°C, atomisation temperature 2300°C for Cu. Quality assurance following German GLP regulations with certified reference materials.)
limitations: GFAAS is probably appropriate for copper quantification in zooplankton.
